formal_title: Prospective Action-Sign Prediction, Third-Mechanism Boundary Transport, Rich Low-Complexity Rival Ecology, Boundary-Carrying Obligation Replication, Path-Semantic Intervention, Leave-Two-Mechanisms-Out Generalization, Frozen Principle Survival Test & Macro-Law Predictive Calibration
scientific_target: Move from retrospective structural accommodation to prospectively correct action-sign prediction on a third mechanistically distinct family, while competing against richer low-complexity rivals.

states.meaning: A direct path whose relevant boundary carries the semantic obligation/metadata preserves the client-observable intent.
At least one relevant intermediate boundary that does not carry/forward the semantic obligation causes the downstream intent to be lost or normalized away.
An explicit semantic channel bypasses the need for legacy/implicit compatibility propagation and preserves the intended distinction end-to-end.

prospective_sign_rule.failure_rule: Any admitted exact third-family cell whose sign disagrees with its pre-frozen state classification falsifies BOUNDARY_TRANSPORT_SIGN_V1 for that family.

R0_TYPED_BOUNDARY_TRANSPORT.prediction_rule: Use the three pre-frozen semantic states and their +/−/+ signs.

R1_BINARY_TRIGGER.prediction_rule: Any compatibility/propagation-active non-explicit surface receives the same sign.

R2_WRAPPER_PENALTY.prediction_rule: Any wrapper-mediated path is negative; direct and explicit paths positive.

R3_PATH_LENGTH_THRESHOLD.prediction_rule: Paths of length <=1 positive; paths of length >=2 negative; explicit channel positive regardless of path length.

R4_ALL_EDGES_MUST_CARRY.prediction_rule: Positive iff every relevant traversed boundary carries the semantic marker/capability; explicit end-to-end channel is positive.

R5_ONE_SPLIT_DECISION_TREE.prediction_rule: Choose exactly one of {explicit?, wrapper?, path_length>1?, carrier_gap?} using only P19/P20 development evidence; split identity must be frozen before fresh third-family outcome.

R6_UNTYPED_LOOKUP.prediction_rule: No prediction for unseen mechanism-local states.

rival_preselection.reason: P20 direct-vs-wrapper result points to missing propagation at an intermediate boundary rather than wrapper-ness or path length alone.

boundary_carrying_obligation.replication_success: A mechanistically distinct family exhibits +/−/+ under the pre-frozen carrier-preserving / carrier-gap / explicit-channel classification.
boundary_carrying_obligation.replication_failure: The third family sign pattern is explained by wrapper/path length but not carrier status, or the carrier-gap cell remains positive.

frozen_principle_test.text: Preserve existing client-observable intent across a compatibility path only while each semantically relevant boundary preserves the required carrier; an explicit end-to-end channel may preserve intent without legacy propagation.
frozen_principle_test.survival_requires: All admitted third-family cells match without adding a qualifier after outcome.

leave_two_mechanisms_out.protocol: After P21 third-family admission, evaluate every admissible train-on-rest / hold-out-two split for representations that define predictions without mechanism-local lookup. Report support-only mechanisms separately from exact mechanisms.

macro_law_predictive_gate.macro_law_authorized_if: A pre-frozen representation wins prospectively on the third exact family and retains boundary predictions under leave-two-out better than all strictly simpler admissible rivals, with no post-hoc coordinates or sign edits.
